description: H2. A payment by the leaf draws down the leaf's allowance, its department's and the company's. Bob is refused by a meter he never touched himself, which is the whole content of a company-wide limit.

requests.note: Ada is now at her own 600.00 ceiling; the department meter reads 600.00 too.
A sibling leaf under the same department. His own meter is empty.
Bob has spent 150.00 of his own 600.00 and is refused: what ran out is the department's, spent by someone else.
